intro: Convert kilograms to pounds instantly using the exact international standard. When comparing kg vs. lb, 1 kilogram equals 2.20462262 avoirdupois pounds (since 1 lb is legally defined as exactly 0.45359237 kg). Whether you need to translate weight from kilograms to pounds for medical charts, Olympic weightlifting plates, or parcel shipping, this calculator computes exact results and lets you inspect our kilos to pounds chart below with clickable rows and worked examples.
alsoWrittenAs: kilograms to pounds, kilo to lb, kilos to lbs, kilogrammes to pounds, kg to lbm

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Exact NIST Factor vs. Early Rounding Drift
items: The exact conversion factor from Kilogram to Pound (Avoirdupois) is 1 ÷ 0.45359237 (≈ 2.20462262), derived from the 1959 International Yard and Pound Agreement.
Multiplying by 2.2 in your head undercounts by roughly 0.21% (over half a pound on 138 kg). Use 2.20462262 for accuracy and round only the displayed total.

faqs.question: How many kilos are in a pound?
faqs.answer: There are exactly 0.45359237 kilograms (kilos) in 1 international avoirdupois pound—about 0.4536 kg, or roughly 454 grams.

faqs.question: How many pounds (lb) are in 1 kilogram (kg)?
faqs.answer: There are 2.20462262 pounds (lb) in 1 kilogram (kg), which rounds to 2.2046 lb for everyday calculations.

faqs.question: How do I convert kilograms to pounds (kg to lb)?
faqs.answer: To convert kilograms to pounds, multiply kilograms by 2.20462262 (or divide by 0.45359237). For example, 20 kg equals 44.09245 lb.

faqs.question: What is 55.5 kg in pounds?
faqs.answer: 55.5 kilograms (kg) equals 122.35656 pounds (lb), or about 122.36 lb, computed using the exact 1959 international pound definition.
